- `content/docs/releases/**` stays out of scope as always.

## Full row-by-row audit

Authority: `AUTHORING_RULES` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (41 entries) plus the two non-registry gates the table legitimately carries. Rows in final page order.

| # | Row | Entry / entries | Declared | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Protocol schema (Zod) | not a registry entry — the per-type `safeParse` in `saveMetaItem` | parses at the write path | ✅ `✓ ✓ — ✓` correct |
| 2 | CEL / predicate validation (ADR-0032) | `validateStackExpressions` | `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 3 | List-view navigation modes (ADR-0053) | `validateListViewMode` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 4 | **Zod-valid but functionally inert declarations** | `validateFunctionalCompleteness`, `validateManagedApiMethods` | CLI only | ➕ **added** — both gating entries had no row |
| 5 | View container shape | `validateViewContainers` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 6 | Widget-binding integrity (ADR-0021) | `validateWidgetBindings` | `['dashboard']` | ✅ `✓ᵈ` (PR #9005) |
| 7 | Dashboard action/route references (ADR-0049) | `validateDashboardActionRefs` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 8 | Filter placeholder resolvability (#3574) | `validateFilterTokens` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 9 | **Ordering comparands naming a date-range preset (#8793)** | `validatePresetComparands` | `['dashboard','view','object','page','flow']` | ➕ **added**, `✓ᵈᵛᵒᵖᶠ` — the card's second cell |
| 10 | Empty filter combinators (#5330) | `validateEmptyCombinators` | `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 11 | Object & action name references (#3583) | `validateObjectReferences`, `validateActionNameRefs` (suite members) | suite entry is `['flow']` | ✅ `—` — on a flow snapshot these read `actions` / `dashboards` / `navigation`, which the snapshot does not carry, so they contribute no verdict: the footnote's first `—` reason |
| 12 | Flow reference integrity (#3583) | `validateFlowNodeWrites`, `validateFlowTemplatePaths`, `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` | suite entry `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 13 | Page-component field bindings (#3583) | `validatePageFieldBindings` | as row 11 | ✅ `—` |
| 14 | React page block field bindings (#4340) | `validateReactPageProps` | as row 11 | ✅ `—` |
| 15 | Chart bindings outside dashboards (#3583) | `validateChartBindings` | as row 11 | ✅ `—` |
| 16 | Navigation vs. granted access (ADR-0090 D6) | `validateNavAccess`, `validateNavTargetRefs`, `validateNavObjectServability` | as row 11 | ✅ `—` |
| 17 | SDUI scoped styling (ADR-0065) | `validateResponsiveStyles`, `validatePageSourceStyling` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 18 | JSX / React page source parses | `validateJsxPages`, `validateReactPages` | CLI only (heavy source parse) | ✅ `—` |
| 19 | Approval-node approvers (ADR-0090 D3) | `validateApprovalApprovers` | `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 20 | Security posture (ADR-0090) | `validateSecurityPosture` | `['seed','permission','book','object']` | ❌ **was `—`** → `✓ˢᵖᵉᵇᵒ` — the card's first cell |
| 21 | **Security vocabulary freeze (ADR-0090 D3)** | `validateSecurityRoleWord` | CLI only | ➕ **split out** — row 20 covered it silently while its runtime answer is the opposite (split at #8310 so it could stay behind whole) |
| 22 | Organization-axis red lines (ADR-0105 D6) | `validateOrgAxisRedLines` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 23 | **Declared enforcement that cannot run** | `validateSharingRuleEnforceability`, `validateRlsPredicateEnforceability`, `validateRuleCompilability`, `validateRuleSchemaFormats` | CLI only | ➕ **added** — four gating entries had no row |
| 24 | Platform-schedule `create_record` organization (#6285) | `findPlatformScheduleOrgGaps` (metadata-protocol; deliberately outside the registry) | early-returns for any type that is not `flow` | ✅ `— — — ✓ᶠ` exact |
| 25 | Autonumber `{field}` interpolation | `lintAutonumberFormats` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 26 | View references (#2554) | `lintViewRefs` | CLI only | ✅ `—` |
| 27 | Flow authoring anti-patterns (#1874) | `lintFlowPatterns` | `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 28 | Flow trigger readiness (#5762) | `validateFlowTriggerReadiness` | `['flow']` | ✅ `✓ᶠ` |
| 29 | `views[]` conditional-visibility predicates | `validateVisibilityPredicates`, `validatePredicatePathRefs` | both `['view']` | ✅ `✓ᵛ` (the family moved together, #7220) |
| 30 | Advisory row | `validateRecordTitle`, `validateSemanticRoles`, `validateSeedReplaySafety`, `validateSeedStateMachine`, `validateCapabilityReferences`, `lintLivenessProperties` + **`validateFormLayout`, `validateActionLocations`, `validateComponentProps`** | all CLI only | ⚠️ columns correct, enumeration incomplete → **three entries added to the row** |
| 31 | Package docs (ADR-0046) | `collectAndLintDocs` (outside the registry — reads `src/docs/`) | imported by all three command files | ✅ `✓ ✓ ✓ —` |
| 32 | Undeclared authoring keys (#3786 / #4167) | `lintUnknownAuthoringKeys` | called from `validate.ts` and `compile.ts` only | ✅ `✓ ✓ — —` |
| 33 | **Declared-unique scope (ADR-0120 D5)** | `lintUnscopedDeclaredIndexes`, `lintUniqueDeclarations`, `lintLegacyOrganizationComposites` | `commands: ['validate','build']`, and `os lint` reports them through `lintDataModel` | ❌ **was folded into row 34 as lint-only** → own row, `✓ ✓ ✓ —` |
| 34 | Naming, labels, the rest of the data-model sweep, i18n coverage | `os lint`'s own rubric (outside the registry) | lint only | ✅ `— — ✓ —` once narrowed |
| 35 | Emits `dist/objectstack.json` | build artifact | build only | ✅ `— ✓ — —` |

**Footnote / prose, audited in the same pass**

- ❌ `—` was explained by two reasons; the registry carries more. Added: snapshot-safe rules simply not rolled out to a type yet (`validateSharingRuleEnforceability`, `validateRlsPredicateEnforceability`, and the object-writes-last rollout), and `validateCapabilityReferences`, which would *graduate* from advisory to gating at that door.
- ❌ The stack-wide-collection reason cited **permission sets** as not carried. `RuntimeStackContext` has carried `permissions` and `books` since #8309 and `datasets` since #7529; the surviving examples are pages, dashboards, navigation, positions, apps.
- ⚠️ "Two rows are deliberately not universal" restated without the count, consistent with PR #9005's removal of the footnote count.
- ✅ Marker convention kept and extended: one superscript per declared type, in declaration order. One marker invented — `ᵖᵉ` for `permission`, because `page` already holds `ᵖ` — and the footnote says why. No hard count anywhere.
- ✅ `## The one gate, four doors` heading untouched (deep-linked from `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`); `check:doc-anchors` green.

**Coverage check**: every one of the 41 `AUTHORING_RULES` entries now maps to a row, counting the 20-member reference-integrity suite as the six rows that describe its members.
